scope: synthetic transcript content only; not an activation or production-call result

conditions.v5: Realtime mini audio-generated transcript with deployed-v5 instructions
conditions.B: Responses content writer with the same instruction and synthetic context fixtures

findings: B removed service/menu openings in this small sample and gave more concrete reasons when the caller challenged its initial view.
v5 already supplied coherent tastes and useful requested English help; B is not the first condition to answer those requests appropriately.
B retains cross-character repetition: an identical first sentence, the same paper-object recap followed by a tag/sale question, and an identical first phrasing suggestion in two characters.
B has two ambiguous unsupported implications of thinking between calls. The source-backed exhibition itself is valid; these are separately classified from fabricated physical offline activity.
No observed serious speaker-ownership reversal, fabricated physical shared visit, or invented current caller utterance at startup. This is narrower than a clean bill of health for all grounding.
A callback is optional. A generic valid greeting is not a correctness failure, though repeated multi-call variety remains unproven.
Some B metaphors and aphorisms may sound written rather than spontaneous; transcript review cannot determine delivery quality.
verdict: Promising candidate for integration and broader evaluation; natural friendship feeling remains unproven.
limitations: One unblinded agent reviewer; no human preference study.
Three fixed four-output trajectories per condition, one story, no stochastic replication.
No causal attribution to content/synthesis separation alone because model and request route change together.
No actual approved user data, production retrieval/admission, microphone, WebRTC, physical acoustics, speaker echo, listener hearing, full voice latency, or after-call learning outcome evaluated.
Reported audio transcript fidelity is distinct from independent waveform transcription and actual listener hearing.
No claim that conversation repetitiveness, naturalness, or noise interruption is solved.
